preconditions.description: The contract must have liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell + burnFeeOnBuy + burnFeeOnSell = 0, which can be achieved by setting all these fee parameters to zero via setBuyFeePercentages and setSellFeePercentages functions
Attacker must have owner privileges to call setBuyFeePercentages and setSellFeePercentages functions

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setBuyFeePercentages(0,0,0,0) and setSellFeePercentages(0,0,0,0) to set all liquidity and burn fees to zero. Then trigger a transfer that calls _takeLiquidity function, which will attempt division by zero at line 639: liquidityAmount = tLiquidity * (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell) / (liquidityFeeonBuy + liquidityFeeonSell + burnFeeOnBuy + burnFeeOnSell). This will cause a division by zero revert, potentially blocking fee processing and disrupting contract functionality.
